Affectionate & kind hearted human, 
I'm Dr. Hansika Singh, a veterinarian and a passionate animal lover. Since my childhood I've been loving animals so much so that I decided to choose veterinary science as my career. I'd adopted two pet dogs who inspired me to learn more and more about them. I am generous in sharing my knowledge about these lovely creatures. 

If you are an aspiring vet, veterinary student, veterinarian or an animal lover then please subscribe to my channel which is dedicated to the wellness of animals. :)
